description: Land Acquisition - Hiriyalagammana, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Maramba, Akuressa D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information, for the purpose of government acquisition. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it pertains to land acquisitions and property matters.
